name: NEURA Quadruped
summary: A four-legged robot from the German maker NEURA Robotics for inspection, surveillance and payload transport on rough ground and stairs, with autonomous navigation and ROS 2. Open for reservation at an estimated 50,000 € per unit, with availability expected in 2026.

germany.statusNote: NEURA Robotics (Metzingen, Germany) takes refundable 100 € reservations for single units on its site; estimated price 50,000 € excluding taxes and shipping; expected to be available in 2026. Commercial quantities through the contact form. No deliveries confirmed.

priceEur.note: "Estimated price/unit 50,000 € (excluding taxes and shipping)"; reservation fee "100€ per unit", credited to the purchase price.
